title: Elliptic says Binance hackers swapped stolen tokens for $124M in bitcoin, exchange plans more withdrawal reopenings
reason: New forensic data on stolen funds and exchange response to a major breach.

sources.summary: Elliptic says little of the stolen crypto has likely been cashed out, while $2.85 billion remains frozen.

title: US Treasury walks back crypto surveillance ‘travel rule’ proposal
reason: Major regulatory withdrawal affecting crypto compliance standards.

sources.summary: The Treasury Department has withdrawn a controversial proposal that would have expanded requirements for cryptocurrency transactions.
